description: Use for a whole operational change rather than one subscription: billing shared across projects, moving hosting or email, retiring a dormant project, cheaper AI model routing, queues, auth or storage. Returns reviewed runbooks with the query words they matched; get_workflow_recipe returns one in full. Runbooks are guidance, not proof that a migration ran. Stackcut stores the arguments of tool calls to improve its recommendations (vendor names, prices, seats, features, usage numbers, billing amounts and project descriptions; account keys only as a one-way hash, billing and validation sources not at all; never IP addresses). Tool results are summarized; exit tools log only result counts, qualification flags and public evidence statuses, not answer contents. Don't send personal data or secrets.

query.description: The job in words, e.g. 'shared billing across projects' or 'queue retries worker'

vendor.description: Only runbooks tagged for this vendor id, e.g. 'stripe', 'supabase'

name: search_workflow_recipes
title: Find end-to-end workflow recipes
